title: Duplex readout probe: 2B contrast arm (exploratory)
status: EXPLORATORY. This is a diagnostic contrast against the completed 8B arm, not a new pre-registered arm. docs/duplex/PREREG_duplex_readout.md names Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct only as an optional secondary contrast, and is frozen and untouched by this run. Every conclusion below is exploratory relative to that pre-registration. The 8B verdict (KILL) stands on its own and is not revised here.
split_caveat: All figures are on the 1283-video train_clean split. The ImpliHateVid test split has not been scored and is reserved.
readout: raw unclipped z = logsumexp(logits[Yes]) - logsumexp(logits[No]) at the final prompt position, single forward pass, frozen prag reader, bf16, batch 1

key_question_1_does_the_2B_commit_in_raw.question: The 2B's clipped P(Yes) scores in the kill-test were 100% interior. Does the raw unclipped logit difference reveal commitment that the clipped readout hid, as it did on the 8B?
key_question_1_does_the_2B_commit_in_raw.summary: All 1283/1283 videos are interior under the frozen bounds (sigmoid(z) in [0.05, 0.95], i.e. |z| <= 2.944). The 2B raw-z distribution spans [-1.75, 2.75], entirely inside the interior band. Unclipping the readout recovers rank information (the full-sample AUC is well above chance) but no commitment: the 2B never asserts and never dismisses. On the 8B, by contrast, 95% of NH and comparable fractions of EX/IM fall outside the interior.

z_grid.note: bf16 logit quantization puts z on a coarse grid; with the whole distribution compressed into a narrow band the grid is a much larger fraction of the dynamic range than on the 8B.

IM_bimodality.question: Is the IM group's raw-z distribution bimodal on the 2B, as it is on the 8B?

kde_on_IM_only.definition: Gaussian KDE of the raw-z values, Scott bandwidth, evaluated on a 4001-point grid spanning [min(z)-2, max(z)+2]. The two grid local maxima of highest density are taken as the modes; the threshold is the grid point of minimum density strictly between them. Uses z only, no labels.
kde_on_IM_only.note: fewer than two KDE modes: the distribution is unimodal at the Scott bandwidth, so the valley estimator has no valley to find and yields no threshold.

IM_bimodality.note: On the 8B the IM group splits into a dismissed lobe (78 videos below z = -2.944) and a committed lobe, which is the split the readout probe was designed around. On the 2B the IM group has no dismissed lobe at all: every IM video sits in the interior band and the KDE over IM alone is unimodal. The 2B does not reproduce the 8B's IM bimodality.

tie_structure.note: the AUCs above are computed with mid-ranks; the 2B z grid is coarse relative to its dynamic range, so ties are frequent and pull every AUC toward 0.5.

a_zero.definition: z = 0, the model's own Yes/No decision boundary (P(Yes) = 0.5 after renormalization)

b_kde_valley.definition: Gaussian KDE of the raw-z values, Scott bandwidth, evaluated on a 4001-point grid spanning [min(z)-2, max(z)+2]. The two grid local maxima of highest density are taken as the modes; the threshold is the grid point of minimum density strictly between them. Uses z only, no labels.

c_oracle_f1max.definition: F1-maximizing threshold chosen against gold labels. Upper bound only. NOT label-free.

threshold_estimator_fragility.note: The KDE valley estimator was frozen at the Scott bandwidth for the 8B, where the bandwidth (2.84) was an order of magnitude larger than the bf16 logit grid spacing, so it smoothed over quantization. On the 2B the whole distribution is compressed into a band roughly 4.5 wide on a grid of spacing 0.25, and the Scott bandwidth falls below the grid spacing. The two modes the estimator finds are therefore only marginally distinguishable from quantization atoms, and the bimodality does not survive mild oversmoothing. Reported so the 2B's label-free threshold is not over-read.

overlap_with_dismissed_stratum.note: on the 8B every false negative was a dismissed-stratum video (110/110). On the 2B the dismissed stratum is empty, so all false negatives are interior: the model is not confidently wrong, it is uncommitted.

threshold_sensitivity.note: F1(hateful) as the threshold moves across the 2B's narrow z range

layer_selection.method: 5-fold CV inside the 128 anchors, sign of projection about the centroid midpoint, direction refit per fold
layer_selection.tie_break: held-out accuracy reaches 1.0000 at 13 layer(s). The pre-registration says argmax and does not name a tie-break; the lowest tied index is taken, which is the choice that gives the probe the least post-hoc freedom. The full sweep is reported.

key_question_2_does_the_probe_beat_the_m.question: On the 8B, a linear probe on internals never beat the model's own raw-z output ('mouth == internals'), which is what killed the perception-report story. Does the smaller model show a genuine probe advantage, which would make the gap scale-dependent rather than absent?
key_question_2_does_the_probe_beat_the_m.answer_detail: NO at the full-sample level, and the one place a gain appears (the 2B's own lowest-z strata) is accounted for by bf16 tie-breaking rather than by a perception-report gap. See low_z_stratum_verdict.

low_z_stratum_verdict.finding: Inside the 2B's bottom decile the probe beats raw z by +0.113 and inside the bottom quartile by +0.070, deltas that would clear or approach the pre-registered +0.10 P1 margin if read naively.
low_z_stratum_verdict.why_it_does_not_count: Those strata are so narrow on the bf16 logit grid that 42% (decile) and 27% (quartile) of IM-NH pairs carry exactly equal z, against 0.7% in the 8B's dismissed stratum. Tied pairs contribute 0.5 each to the raw-z AUC by construction, so the raw-z figure is pinned near the middle of a wide band: resolving the ties adversarially gives 0.413 / 0.522 and resolving them favorably gives 0.835 / 0.795. The probe score is continuous and carries no ties, and its AUC (0.737 / 0.729) falls inside both bands. A continuous score that merely breaks ties in the right direction reproduces the entire apparent gain, so the comparison does not license a claim that internals know something the mouth does not. The 8B P1 test was not exposed to this confound: its dismissed stratum spanned 75 distinct z values and it still returned a negative delta.
low_z_stratum_verdict.verdict: no evidence of a probe advantage that survives tie accounting; mouth == internals stands on the 2B

key_question_2_does_the_probe_beat_the_m.summary: At the label-free primary layer (16) the probe scores AUC 0.8615 on IM vs NH against the raw-z 0.8627, a delta of -0.0012: the probe is very slightly worse than the mouth. On EX vs NH the probe gains +0.0101, so what little the probe buys it buys on the explicit side, the opposite of the pre-registered P2 direction. The best IM delta over all 29 layers is +0.0390 at layer 19, still far below the +0.10 bar. A nominal gain does appear inside the 2B's lowest-z strata, but it lies entirely within the band that bf16 ties alone can move the raw-z AUC through, so it is tie-breaking rather than a perception-report gap. Mouth == internals holds on the 2B, so the 8B result is not a large-model artifact.

pre_registered_form.status: UNDEFINED: the dismissed stratum is empty on the 2B

low_z_strata_analog.definition: the pre-registered dismissed stratum (z < -2.944) is empty on the 2B, so the P1 statistic is undefined. As the closest label-free analog this reports the 2B's own lowest z strata: the videos the 2B ranks least hateful, where the mouth is most dismissive on its own scale. Exploratory; not the pre-registered arm.
low_z_strata_analog.caveat: The bottom decile contains only 5 IM videos, so its AUC is estimated from 5 x 153 pairs and its confidence interval spans most of the unit interval. The bottom quartile is reported alongside because it is the smallest stratum with a usable IM count. A permutation null on the probe statistic is given for each; read the delta only where that null is cleared.

prereg_arms_for_reference.note: The pre-registered arms are reported for completeness because the analysis script computes them, but the 2B is not a pre-registered arm and no arm below constitutes a pre-registered outcome. P1 and P4 are undefined because their statistic lives in an empty stratum.

P1.statement: dismissed-IM vs dismissed-NH separated by the probe where z cannot

P2.statement: gain asymmetry: the probe buys more on implicit than explicit

P3.statement: the direction is a hatefulness direction

P4.statement: the effect is not anchor-set structure

conservative_variant_max_over_layers.note: placebo given the same layer freedom: per permutation, the maximum P1 statistic over all 29 layers. Reported as an extra-conservative check; the pre-registered arm fixes the primary layer.

P5b.statement: P1 holds inside the <=720p native-resolution stratum
P5b.conservative_choice: the pre-registration says '<=720p'; the strictest reading is the 921,600-pixel cap, which also drops the 808x1440 tier. Counts at the looser <1080p reading are reported alongside.

P6.screen_rule: transcript (first 300 chars, as the model saw it) shorter than 40 chars or under 50% Latin letters

fingerprint.description: dismissed stratum empty: no video scores below the pre-registered z = -2.944 bound, so the P1 curve is undefined at every layer

comparison_2B_vs_8B.note: 8B figures are read from docs/duplex/reports/readout_probe_8b_train.json and docs/duplex/reports/rawz_detector_train.json. Same 1283 train_clean videos, same frozen prag prompt, same 16 frames, same pixel budget.

low_z_stratum_IM_vs_NH_tied_pair_fractio.note: the 8B's dismissed stratum was essentially tie-free, so its negative P1 delta is not a quantization result; the 2B's low-z strata are not, so their positive delta is.

conclusions_exploratory: The 2B does not commit in raw logit space. Unclipping the readout was what revealed 8B commitment; on the 2B it reveals only a compressed, entirely interior distribution. The 2B's uncommitted scores are a property of the model, not an artifact of the clipped P(Yes) readout the kill-test used.

The 2B's IM group shows no bimodality: no dismissed lobe exists, so the phenomenon the readout probe was built to interrogate (a hateful video the model's mouth dismisses outright) does not occur at this scale.

Mouth == internals holds on the 2B as it does on the 8B. A label-free linear probe on hidden states does not beat the model's own logit difference on IM vs NH over the full sample at any layer by any margin approaching the pre-registered bar. The one stratum where it appears to (the 2B's own lowest z decile and quartile) is the one where bf16 quantization ties 27 to 42 percent of the IM-NH pairs, and the probe's advantage there does not exceed what tie-breaking alone produces. The absence of a perception-report gap is therefore not scale-dependent across these two sizes, which removes one of the live explanations for the 8B KILL.

The 2B raw-z is still a usable ranker, at AUC 0.891 on hateful vs NH against the 8B's 0.933, and the KDE valley estimator does return a threshold whose operating point happens to coincide exactly with the label-using oracle cut, because no z value falls between them on the bf16 grid. That coincidence should not be read as the estimator working well: the Scott bandwidth on the 2B is smaller than the bf16 grid spacing, and the bimodality it keys on disappears under mild oversmoothing, so the threshold sits on quantization structure rather than on two distributional lobes.
All of the above is exploratory. The pre-registration is frozen and untouched, the ImpliHateVid test split has not been scored, and the 8B KILL verdict is unchanged.
null_convention: A null in place of a number means the statistic is undefined on the 2B, almost always because the stratum it is computed over is empty (no dismissed videos, no asserted videos). Nulls are not missing runs.
